langs.description: BCP 47 language tags for the plan's textual content. Mirrors app.bsky.feed.post.langs.

startDate.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for week 1. v1 renders relative week labels and ignores this; retained for a real-dates fast-follow.

mealsPerDay.description: Editor cap: how many meals a day may hold. Absent on records written before multi-meal; readers default it (never below the largest day already placed).

repeat.description: How many times this week stamps onto the expanded calendar, in order.

slot.description: A single day cell holding an ordered list of meals (0..mealsPerDay). The legacy `recipe`/`note` fields describe a single-recipe day written before multi-meal; readers migrate such a slot to a one-entry `meals` list.

meals.description: The meals placed on this day, in order. The meal-type label is not stored — it is derived from each recipe's own category at render time.

recipe.description: Deprecated (pre-multi-meal): a single recipe on this day. Tolerated on read and migrated to `meals`; not written by current clients.

note.description: Deprecated (pre-multi-meal): the note for the single-recipe day. See #meal.note.

meal.description: One placed meal: a recipe strongRef and an optional note. A strongRef cannot declare its target is a recipe (the same open-world caveat the doc records for consumed strongRefs); the app treats `recipe` as a recipe strongRef by construction.

recipe.description: strongRef to the recipe placed on this day.
